        # Downsampling stages

        self.bn1 = BatchNormalization(axis=-1)

        # Final classification layer
        self.conv6 = Conv2D(filters=10, kernel_size=(1, 1), activation='softmax', padding='same')

        x = self.bn5(x)

        # Final classification
